scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:format
scripts.images:webp: mkdir -p dist/full dist/thumb && find pngs -maxdepth 1 -name '*.png' -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1 -P "$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)" sh -c 'n=$(basename "$1" .png); cwebp -q 50 -resize 0 640 -m 6 -sharp_yuv -af -sns 80 -f 70 -pass 8 -alpha_filter best -alpha_q 70 -quiet "$1" -o "dist/full/$n.webp"; cwebp -q 55 -resize 0 160 -m 6 -sharp_yuv -af -sns 80 -f 70 -pass 8 -alpha_filter best -alpha_q 70 -quiet "$1" -o "dist/thumb/$n.webp"' _
scripts.images:upload: aws s3 cp dist/full/ s3://personal-k8s-main-space/thekrausshaus.com/images/cocktails/full-webp/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.webp" --content-type image/webp --acl public-read --endpoint-url https://nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com --profile spaces && aws s3 cp dist/thumb/ s3://personal-k8s-main-space/thekrausshaus.com/images/cocktails/thumbnail-webp/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.webp" --content-type image/webp --acl public-read --endpoint-url https://nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com --profile spaces
